targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT p.start_time AS effective_start, p.end_time AS effective_end FROM partitions p WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[],1),0) = 0 OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])) ), granularity AS ( SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(dynamics.fl_wheel_speed) AS "usm/fl_wheel_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.fr_wheel_speed) AS "usm/fr_wheel_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.bl_wheel_speed) AS "usm/bl_wheel_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.br_wheel_speed) AS "usm/br_wheel_speed [rad/s]", AVG(dynamics.wheel_speed) AS "usm/wheel_speed [rad/s]" FROM dynamics JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = dynamics.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
